original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州警方逮捕涉抢劫与绑架的通缉嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州警方在阿瓦卡北部地方政府区埃贝内贝社区开展情报主导行动，逮捕了26岁通缉嫌疑人乌多楚库·奥卡福（绰号“Small-Moto”）。警方称初步审讯显示，该嫌疑人涉嫌从一名治安人员手中抢走一支泵动式枪械。据警方称，奥卡福因涉嫌参与武装抢劫、绑架、邪教相关活动及分离主义相关罪行而被列入通缉名单。

location.raw_text: Ebenebe community, Awka North Local Government Area, Anambra State

key_facts.fact: 阿南布拉州警方逮捕26岁通缉嫌疑人乌多楚库·奥卡福
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Anambra State Police Command has arrested a 26-year-old wanted suspect, Udochukwu Okafor, popularly known as Small-Moto, during an operation in Ebenebe community, Awka North Local Government Area of the state.

key_facts.fact: 逮捕行动由阿武库祖快速反应小队在周六依据情报实施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: operatives of the Rapid Response Squad, Awkuzu, arrested the suspect on Saturday following an intelligence-led operation

key_facts.fact: 警方称嫌疑人涉嫌从治安人员手中抢走一支泵动式枪械
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the suspect allegedly snatched a pump-action firearm from a vigilante operative in Ebenebe

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人因涉嫌武装抢劫、绑架、邪教及分离主义相关罪行被通缉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Okafor had been on the command’s wanted list over alleged involvement in armed robbery, kidnapping, cult-related activities and secessionist-related offences

uncertainties: 嫌疑人的具体罪行尚未经法院证实，警方表述为涉嫌
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
事件时间在不同来源间存在差异
